text:
Lina Chen: Quick copy check — the 'Revoke API key' confirmation dialog on Console feels a bit harsh. Screenshot attached: https://redwood/mockups/revoke-dialog.png

Alex Patel: I agree, it reads punitive. Also noticed keyboard focus currently lands on the red 'Revoke' button — that's risky for accidental activation. :thinking:

Maya Singh: Strong +1 to moving default focus to the non-destructive action. And we should add a short line explaining what stops working (so admins understand impact).

Chris O'Neil: Proposed copy (headline + body + buttons):

```
Headline: "Revoke API key?"
Body: "This key will stop working immediately. Update any clients using this key before revoking."
Buttons: [Cancel] [Revoke key]
```

Make Cancel the primary focus and ensure pressing Enter doesn't trigger Revoke by default. Also add `aria-describedby` that points to the body text so screen readers announce impact.

Lina Chen: Love the shorter headline. Can we make the body slightly more actionable: "This key will stop working immediately and any running requests will fail. Create a replacement key before revoking." Too wordy?

Alex Patel: How about: "This key will stop working immediately. Update clients before revoking." Short and clear. Keep the more detailed guidance in the API keys help doc link.

Maya Singh: Accessibility nitlist:
- Dialog must trap focus while open.
- Default focus on Cancel (safe action).
- Esc should cancel.
- Ensure Enter on the focused Cancel triggers cancel, not revoke.
- Add visible focus ring on primary button and accessible labels for destructive action (e.g., `aria-label=\"Revoke API key: key-name\"`).

DesignBot: A11y checklist item created: "Revoke API key dialog — default focus on safe action, focus trap, Esc cancels, aria-describedby for impact text." See /docs/a11y/dialogs#revoke-key for reference.

Chris O'Neil: Also let's add a tiny tooltip on the API keys list row: "Revoking a key is irreversible — create replacement first." Short tooltip avoids surprise.

Lina Chen: I'll update the Figma copy and push a small PR with the accessibility changes + the revised copy Alex suggested. Will include the help doc link and the tooltip text.

Alex Patel: Thanks — @Maya can you review the PR when Lina posts it?

Maya Singh: Yep, will review.

Lina Chen: Thanks all :thumbsup:
